proposed_fixes.title: Prevent unzoomed taskbar surfaces from overlaying ZoomIt Live Zoom
proposed_fixes.root_cause: When taskbar flyouts create or update compositor surfaces during Live Zoom, an unzoomed taskbar/flyout surface is presented over the zoomed desktop instead of being incorporated into or excluded consistently from the live-zoom composition.
plan: Reproduce while tracing window and compositor-surface creation for the taskbar and flyout.
Identify whether Live Zoom must capture the new surface or suppress the separate unzoomed presentation.
Add regression coverage for taskbar hover, click flyouts, and repeated open/close while zoomed.
verification: Enable Live Zoom, open multiple taskbar flyouts, and confirm only one zoomed taskbar/flyout presentation is visible.
Repeat on the reported Windows 11 25H2 environment and current stable PowerToys.

confidence.rationale: The visual failure is current and well documented, but the composition mechanism is inferred and needs a graphics trace.

Compare the taskbar and flyout surfaces.
